answer: Seven current forms took effect on February 1, 2026, the date of the rewrite. Four of them are brand new, and the form records mark them "New in 2026": NW-DMG-1 (Damage disclosure), NW-LPA-1 (Lender payoff authorization, for loans only, since leases use NW-LSE-1), NW-MIL-1 (Deployed owner authorization) and NW-PLT-1 (Plate return receipt (California)). NW-EST-1 (Heir and estate affidavit) also started that day, though its record doesn't call it new. The other two replaced older forms: NW-ODO-2 (Odometer disclosure statement) replaced NW-ODO-1, and NW-POA-2 (Power of attorney (e-sign)) replaced the notarized NW-POA-1. An NW-POA-1 signed before February 1 was accepted until June 30, 2026.
